meta.name: Ponies
meta.description: In 1977 Moscow, two "PONIES" ("persons of no interest") become CIA operatives and uncover a Cold War conspiracy their husbands were killed for.

videos.title: Second Hand News
videos.overview: After tragedy strikes, two American women embark on a new life as spies in the Soviet Union.‬

videos.title: Don't Go Breaking My Heart

videos.title: Turn the Beat Around
